class.name: InterDVDStream
class.brief_description: Extra audio or subtitle stream muxed into an [InterDVDCell].
class.description: [member InterDVDCell.audio_path] is stream 0. Additional AC3 audio tracks use [constant KIND_AUDIO] (private stream [code]0x81+[/code]). Caption files ([code].srt[/code], [code].sup[/code]) use [constant KIND_SUBTITLE] and are muxed as [code]dvdsub[/code] (private stream [code]0x20+[/code]). IFO stream tables are written only when that PES exists in the muxed VOB.

members.member: Language code extension (normal, visually impaired, director comments, and so on).
ISO 639-1 language code written into the IFO audio or subpicture attribute table.
Audio file or subtitle file to mux.
